title: pj-engine: open-source browser Jyotish calculation engine with a reproducible benchmark
description: pj-engine is the browser-first Jyotish (Vedic astrology) calculation layer from Pocket Jyotish (https://pocketjyotish.in). It computes kundli, Vimshottari dasha, panchang, Sade Sati and guna milan in browsers and Node 18+, with Lahiri ayanamsa. Benchmarked against the Swiss Ephemeris on 418 charts from 1900 to 2050; every number, tolerance and failure is published in BENCHMARK.md. MIT licensed.
